title: Love Language #2: Quality Time
coreMove: Speak Quality Time by giving focused togetherness: eyes, ears, and willing presence aimed at your spouse, with conversation or activity chosen for connection.

exampleSpecs.audience: spouses weighing advancement against family connection
exampleSpecs.stakes: Career advancement can become lonely success unless the spouse and children remain part of the imagined future.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show professional ambition being tested against family by his side.

exampleSpecs.audience: partners who solve faster than they listen
exampleSpecs.stakes: A failed marriage can teach that advice may bypass the need for a sympathetic ear.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Replace fast advice with listening that communicates love.

exampleSpecs.audience: quiet spouses who need structure for emotional sharing
exampleSpecs.stakes: Daily sharing can train self-revelation when exhaustion makes silence easy.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the three-things exercise to move from event reporting to feelings.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Focused togetherness depends on shared purpose, not on how impressive the activity looks.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Make the activity secondary to togetherness.

exampleSpecs.audience: busy partners whose devices compete with conversation
exampleSpecs.stakes: Visible listening habits make attention something the spouse can experience.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Turn listening from an internal claim into observable behavior.

exampleSpecs.audience: couples building connection through shared experiences
exampleSpecs.stakes: Repeated focused experiences become a memory bank that supports the relationship later.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show a modest activity becoming stored evidence of love.
